verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no retention policies, retention periods, or deletion controls for indexed files, chats, or accounts. Self-hosting and keeping data on-device (khoj-docs-38, khoj-docs-51) and the telemetry opt-out (khoj-docs-21) are adjacent privacy features, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
